# Golden expected-edges fixture: tests/fixtures/golden/python
#
# Format: one edge per line --
#   <source qualname> <EDGE_KIND> <target qualname | UNRESOLVED>
#
# A line starting with `#` (after trimming) is a full-line comment and is
# ignored. A line may end with a trailing `# xfail: <why>` marker to record
# a known-failing edge: excluded from precision/recall, reported every run,
# and flagged loudly if it starts resolving correctly (see
# tests/common/golden.rs's module doc comment and ScoreboardReport).
#
# Scope: only CALLS edges whose source is one of this fixture's own
# symbols count toward precision/recall (see tests/golden_python.rs).
# CONTAINS, EXTENDS, IMPORTS, etc. are out of scope entirely, so they
# can't swamp the score.
#
# Baseline measured 2026-09-23: precision 1.0, recall 1.0 (7/7 CALLS
# edges). No known-failing lines today -- every required call shape in
# this fixture already resolves correctly.

# Plain call: a bare same-module function call.
caller.entry CALLS caller.local_util

# `from x import y` call: format_greeting is bound by name only, not
# through an attribute access on `helper`.
caller.call_imported_helper CALLS helper.format_greeting

# Method call on self.
greeter.Greeter.greet CALLS greeter.Greeter.format

# Receiver-typed call: the annotated parameter `g: Greeter` pins the type.
caller.call_receiver_typed CALLS greeter.Greeter.greet

# Inherited method call: Dog declares no `speak` of its own -- must
# dispatch to Animal.speak via Dog's recorded EXTENDS edge.
caller.call_inherited CALLS animals.Animal.speak

# Ambiguous bare name: `run` is defined in two unrelated modules and
# imported from neither here -- must stay unresolved, not guess.
caller.call_ambiguous CALLS UNRESOLVED

# Call into an external library: `requests` is never indexed (it isn't
# part of this fixture repo), so this must stay unresolved.
caller.call_external CALLS UNRESOLVED
